events.text: Rey: I can help however I can—what’s the latest on the repair drive?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’m still trying to sort out the logistics and make sure we have enough supplies and a clear schedule. If you can help with organizing the drop-off times, that would really ease my mind.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rey: Absolutely — I can help organize the drop-off times. Send me whatever details you have, and I’ll keep it tidy.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive—what still needs doing?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Eli: Absolutely — I’m happy to help get the repair drive going. What do you need from me?

events.text: Rey: That would be really helpful, Faye — thank you. I’ll make sure the repair drive schedule fits around pickup times.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

events.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. We’re gathering tools, tape, batteries, and spare parts, and even a little helps a lot.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Rey: I can help with that—what’s still needed most right now?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Oren: Honestly, anything still helps, but tools and spare parts would be especially great right now. Even a little bit makes a difference.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Rey: I’ll keep an eye out and send folks your way if I hear about a broken step, leaky tap, or busted light.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Sam: Thanks, Rey — I appreciate that. I’ll check our supplies and make a note of anything we still need for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Rey: Sounds good, Sam. Let me know what’s missing, and I can help track it down.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Rey: That works for me — I’ll help set up and organize the supplies on Sunday at the community center. Just tell me what time to be there.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — Sunday at the community center is confirmed. I’m checking the time now, and I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.
events.speaker: Pia
